scripts.label: Tactic fork played
scripts.text: The idea here is a fork: one piece attacking several targets at once.

scripts.label: Tactic fork allowed
scripts.text: This gives the other side a chance to set up a fork, attacking several targets with the same piece.

scripts.label: Tactic fork missed
scripts.text: There was a chance to set up a fork. This move misses that opportunity to attack several targets at once.

scripts.label: Tactic pin played
scripts.text: The key idea is a pin to the king. A piece caught this way cannot leave the line and expose its king.

scripts.label: Tactic pin allowed
scripts.text: This gives the other side a chance to use a pin to the king. A pinned piece cannot leave that line and expose its king.

scripts.label: Tactic pin missed
scripts.text: Another move would have made use of a pin to the king. A piece pinned this way cannot leave the line and expose its king.

scripts.label: Tactic skewer played
scripts.text: A skewer is the idea here. When the front piece moves, it exposes the piece behind it.

scripts.label: Tactic skewer allowed
scripts.text: This opens the door to a skewer from the other side. Moving the front piece could expose a piece behind it.

scripts.label: Tactic skewer missed
scripts.text: A stronger move offered a skewer. Moving the front piece would then expose the piece behind it.

scripts.label: Tactic removing defender played
scripts.text: Watch what the defender protects. Capturing it is the idea here, so notice what would lose its protection.

scripts.label: Tactic removing defender allowed
scripts.text: This gives the other side a chance to capture a defender. Look at what could be left without its protection.

scripts.label: Tactic removing defender missed
scripts.text: Another move offered a way to capture a defender, taking protection away from what it was guarding.

scripts.label: Tactic back rank played
scripts.text: The pattern to notice is a back-rank mate, with the king boxed in by its own pieces.

scripts.label: Tactic back rank allowed
scripts.text: This gives the other side a route to a back-rank mate. The pattern traps the king behind its own pieces.

scripts.label: Tactic back rank missed
scripts.text: There was a route to a back-rank mate. This move lets that chance slip away.

scripts.label: Tactic promotion awareness played
scripts.text: The idea is to get a pawn to the last rank and promote it. Follow its route to see how.

scripts.label: Tactic promotion awareness allowed
scripts.text: This gives the other side a chance to promote a pawn. Watch how it could reach the last rank.

scripts.label: Tactic promotion awareness missed
scripts.text: A stronger move offered a path to promotion. This move misses the chance to bring a pawn to the last rank.

scripts.label: Tactic discovered attack played
scripts.text: The idea is to move a piece out of the way and uncover an attack from another. Look at the line it opens.

scripts.label: Tactic discovered attack allowed
scripts.text: This opens the door to a discovered attack. The other side can move a piece aside to uncover a threat from another.
